questions.question: Simplify: (x³)⁴
questions.explanation: Using power rule (aᵐ)ⁿ = aᵐⁿ: (x³)⁴ = x^(3·4) = x¹².

questions.question: Simplify: x⁵ · x⁻³
questions.explanation: Product rule: aᵐ · aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ. So x⁵ · x⁻³ = x^(5-3) = x².
steps: 1. Apply product rule: aᵐ · aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ.
questions.fastStrategy: Product rule: aᵐ · aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ; add exponents.

questions.question: Simplify: √(16x⁴)
questions.explanation: √(16x⁴) = √16 · √(x⁴) = 4 · x² = 4x². (For principal square root, we take positive.)
questions.fastStrategy: Separate square root of product; even powers become half their exponent.

questions.question: Simplify: (2³)⁰
questions.explanation: Any nonzero number to the power 0 equals 1. (2³)⁰ = 1.
steps: 1. Recall rule: a⁰ = 1 for any a ≠ 0.
questions.fastStrategy: Zero exponent rule: a⁰ = 1 for a ≠ 0.

questions.question: Simplify: √(x⁶/y²)
questions.fastStrategy: For even exponent under square root, divide exponent by 2.
